title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
gist: Google Research and the Stanford Accelerator for Learning launched "Polar Peaks", the third AI Quest for students aged 11 to 14, built on a decade of connectomics research including the complete fruit fly brain map. The series has passed 400,000 completed quests in 10 languages and is paired with new teacher training modules.

insights.claim: Google Research and the Stanford Accelerator for Learning launched "Polar Peaks", the third quest in the AI Quests series, which teaches students ages 11 to 14 how AI works and how to use it responsibly.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: Google is using free educational products to shape early AI literacy among children.
insights.quote: Today, we’re launching “Polar Peaks”, our third quest in the AI Quests series

insights.claim: In Polar Peaks students scan and map neurons to explain a game character's memory loss, doing tasks such as data cleaning and model testing, so they learn firsthand that AI needs careful human oversight and critical thinking.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: The curriculum frames AI as a tool needing human oversight, which suits the responsible-AI message Google wants to convey.
insights.locator: With the guidance of in-game mentors

insights.claim: The quest draws on over a decade of Google research in connectomics, the science of mapping neural networks in the brain, and ends with two researchers discussing real breakthroughs such as the complete fruit fly brain map, the largest brain map by number of neurons to date.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: Google ties a consumer education product to a credible research program that supports its science-for-AI narrative.
insights.quote: the recent mapping of the complete fruit fly brain, the largest brain map by number of neurons to date
insights.locator: The quest is inspired by over a decade

themes.theme: AI Quests series scale and track record

insights.claim: More than 400,000 AI Quests have been completed to date, and the quests are localized into 10 languages.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: This gives a concrete adoption figure for the free program, which is modest next to Google's consumer scale.
insights.quote: More than 400,000 quests have been completed to date, localized to 10 languages.

insights.claim: The first two quests covered flood forecasting and eye disease detection, drawn from Google Research's Flood Forecasting initiative and its diabetic retinopathy screening model, so each quest turns a real Google AI deployment into a lesson.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: The series works as a showcase of Google's applied AI for social good.
insights.locator: Polar Peaks: A journey to map the human brain

insights.claim: AI Quests won a 2026 Webby Award for AI Education, Learning & Training and Best Global K-12 Learning Solution at the ETIH Innovation Awards.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: Awards add external validation that supports school and partner adoption.
insights.locator: Earlier this year, AI Quests won

themes.theme: Teacher enablement through Google AI Educator Series

insights.claim: Google is releasing dedicated teacher training modules inside the Google AI Educator Series so educators can fit AI Quests into existing curricula. Modules for Quests 1 and 2 are available now and the Quest 3 module follows next month.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: Teacher training is the distribution channel that moves the product from a game into classrooms.
insights.quote: The training module for Quest #3 will follow next month.
insights.locator: Training modules: Tools for teaching AI literacy

insights.claim: Google plans to keep working with educators and partners to bring more quests to more classrooms this school year.
insights.speaker: Ronit Levavi Morad
insights.so_what: It signals more quests and a wider school footprint, with no specific numbers.
insights.locator: Earlier this year, AI Quests won
